SELECT s.*, latest.outer_code, latest.outer_trace_no, latest.outer_quantity, latest.binding_active, latest.bound_at FROM dbo.tyco_packing_session s OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP(1) o.raw_code AS outer_code, o.trace_no AS outer_trace_no, o.quantity AS outer_quantity, b.is_active AS binding_active, b.bound_at FROM dbo.tyco_packing_binding b JOIN dbo.tyco_packing_session o ON o.id=b.outer_id WHERE b.inner_id=s.id AND ORDER BY b.bound_at DESC,b.id DESC ) latest
